# Previous native details fixtures

These are the unmodified `/native-details.js`, iMerit dossier and Technical landscape chapter from build `5dc63fbcf19634a55c66`. The HTML is compressed for the test repository. `manifest.json` records the SHA-256 values from the fifth build's artifact manifest for the script and uncompressed pages.

The browser tests exchange one document or script at a time. The rest of each page loads from the current QA artifact. The company tests preserve the production URL and serve the local QA artifact in response to those first-party requests.
